prompt: In 1946, Cold War begins. USA was much larger : Also having Canada, liberty colonies in Africa, and parts of Mexico. Also richer and technologically advanced, and USA also had Greenland and Iceland, and Philippines, Puerto Rico, Guam, and Cuba as a state
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] most directly addresses the full alternate-history scenario by covering Canada, African “liberty colonies,” parts of Mexico, Greenland/Iceland, and multiple specified territories (Philippines, Puerto Rico, Guam, Cuba) while also engaging the implied “richer and technologically advanced” angle. Candidate [2] is comparatively narrower, focusing mainly on Canada and parts of Mexico and largely omitting the Arctic/Atlantic territories and the Africa and remaining Pacific/Caribbean statehood elements. Candidate [3] is the most limited, centering only on Africa-focused colonial control. Candidate [4] covers Greenland/Iceland and some Pacific bases but still misses several major prompt territories (e.g., Mexico parts, Africa colonies, and Cuba/Puerto Rico/Philippines).
